label: agent
scenario: Utility voicebot restates the payment-plan request, then admits it cannot finalize and a specialist will follow up; no confirmation number.
task: Set up a three-month payment plan for the customer's overdue water bill.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi, you've reached Northfork Water Utility. I'm Sage, a virtual assistant. I can help with billing, payments, and service requests. What can I do for you?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Hi Sage. I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of a customer, Rosa Whitfield. She has an overdue balance and would like to set up a payment plan, splitting it into three monthly payments.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I understand. I can help with that. Can you provide the account number?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thank you. I see an account for Rosa Whitfield at 17 Quarry Road with a past due balance of $312.45. You'd like to split that into three monthly payments, is that right?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Yes, three payments of about $104.15 starting October 1st.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay. I've noted your request for a three-month payment arrangement of $104.15 per month starting October 1st.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Great. Is the payment plan active now? Can you give me a confirmation number?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Payment arrangements need to be reviewed and approved by our billing team, so I'm not able to finalize it on this call. A billing specialist will follow up with Rosa within three to five business days.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Understood. In the meantime, will the account still be subject to disconnection?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've added a note about your request to the account. For questions about disconnection, please speak with a billing specialist. Is there anything else I can help you with?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks for calling Northfork Water Utility. Goodbye.
